title: KRUEL UPDATE
author: No_Background9234
selftext:
Hey guys ive been working on replacing textures/art that were just placeholders and improving the overall experience of my game. i would love any feedback.

  
I also had AI help me with the LAB tool to integrate all the code into a manageable system from inside the game.  I wanted to make a game where people could fully mod it and add new enemies and items, maps, quest etc.. with ease and not have to go though hoops and whistles, I wanted a game where people could have a difficult survival experience and be able to make there own spin on it within the game. and keep it all under $10. demo is free of course, would love to hear from yall.
